caveat: scalp EEG: volume conduction mixes hub and periphery; NAS on sensor data needs the forward-model validation of the applicability registry (eeg_like_forward) first
hub_rule: fronto-parietal sensors F3, F1, Fz, F2, F4, P3, P1, Pz, P2, P4
node_order: sorted channel names (the pipeline's EEG preprocessing picks the channels common to a subject's runs in sorted order); valid only for recordings whose kept scalp EEG channels are exactly channel_order; on another layout the indices can be in range but name other channels, e.g. ds005620 (62 scalp channels): derive its hub from its channels.tsv with --eeg-channels
status: EXAMPLE - not preregistered. The hub is a substantive measurement choice: preregister it (with this derivation) before any confirmatory use.
